title: DISINTEGRATE -- one-knob stereo effect that breaks a sound down to silence

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn the disintegrate dial: 0 = clean bypass, 1 = silence.
On the way up the sound wobbles in pitch, saturates, then the filters close in from both ends.
The last stretch (above ~0.85) fades the output to nothing.
The number below the dial shows the current amount. It resets to 0 when the patch loads.

sections.heading: AS A BPATCHER
lines: Inlets: audio L, audio R, amount (float 0-1 -- the dial follows it).
Outlets: audio L, audio R. No adc~, dac~ or output gain inside -- the host provides those.
See disintegrate-helper.maxpat: live input, output gain + meters, and an automated amount sweep.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: One gen~ codebox, driven by a single amount Param (smoothed, so dial jumps do not click).
Each stage -- tape wobble, drive, low/high-pass narrowing, gain fade -- ramps over its own range.
Near 0 the effect crossfades to the dry signal, so 0 is a true bypass.
